lines.text: How's the knee been since last time?
Since last time the swelling has gone right down, I can get my heel flat on the floor now.
Great, let me have a look. Lie back for me.
Straightens fully, bends to a hundred and ten, scar's healing nicely.
Now, come in, come in, bring your foot in towards your bottom as far as it'll go. Good, hello, that's new, you've never got that far before.
Welcome to the next stage then, we'll get you on the bike.
Ten minutes on a static bike every day, low resistance, seat high, and no pivoting or twisting on that leg for another six weeks.
Can I go back to football?
Not yet. Football is at least six months away, possibly nine, depending on your strength testing.
